title: SourceCategory
description: One category of the sources registry and how long OpenVibe.Sources keeps its items (roadmap §3 F). The window is what stops the registry's items growing linearly: every category says for itself how long its items live, so a consumer knows how long an item may be there and Sources prunes what the category no longer keeps. The age of an item is the last time it was current: its last fetch while it is live, its removal once it is removed. The categories are the ones sources.source@1 and sources.item@1 use.

key.description: The category's key: the same value sources.source@1's category and sources.item@1's category carry.

retention.description: How long Sources keeps an item of this category: a window in days, or "keep" for reference data that is never pruned by age.

days.description: The window in days: an item is kept until it has been out of date for that long.

reason.description: Why this window: the consumer that reads the category and the copy it keeps, so a reviewer can change the window on evidence.

oneOf.description: Reference data, never pruned by age: Sources keeps the newest row per source key and prunes only the rows a newer value replaced (a yearly Fair Market Rent, replaced each October).
